name: iCloud
summary:
iCloud is Apple’s web suite at icloud.com. Its tab icon is not the apple.com corporate favicon. The files below are the ones this host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against icloud.com. HTML came from https://www.icloud.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: apple-touch-icon 180x180 → https://www.icloud.com/favicons/default-favicon-light-180x180.png; icon 32x32 → https://www.icloud.com/favicons/default-favicon-light-32x32.png; icon → https://www.icloud.com/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.icloud.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

An apple-touch-icon URL was declared (https://www.icloud.com/favicons/default-favicon-light-180x180.png), but that response was not saved as an image, so there is no apple-touch download on this page.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.
